algorithms.name: conservative shape bounds
algorithms.preserved: filled edges, stroked edge extents, inverse stroke expansion, finite checks, conservative full tile, 4x4 footprint and roundoff margin
algorithms.job_storage: bounds builder converted; full owner algorithm not complete

algorithms.name: boundary mask and work cap
algorithms.preserved: edge and miter boxes, unique bit count, checked area sum, 200000000 work cap, out-of-range test is true
algorithms.job_storage: ordinary boundaries converted; clip boundaries not converted

algorithms.name: clip boundary culling
algorithms.preserved: two controlled visits, exact preflight visits/edge costs, invalid mapping forces full mask
algorithms.job_storage: ordinary boundaries converted; clip boundaries not converted

algorithms.name: scanline row event index
algorithms.preserved: 5 y samples, event/tie ordering, AVL insert/remove, ascending edge and shape order, explicit row capacities
algorithms.job_storage: event construction converted; rows not converted

algorithms.name: uniform fill fast path
algorithms.preserved: uniform colors, no visible stroke, at most 4096 edges, heap crossing order, nonzero/evenodd winding, binary interval conversion and center/subpixel runs
algorithms.job_storage: not converted to accepted job buffers

algorithms.name: oversized fill fallback
algorithms.preserved: shape remains eligible for scalar path; no refusal
algorithms.job_storage: not converted to accepted job buffers

algorithms.name: render work budget and preflight
algorithms.preserved: 200M base; 1048576 ramp start; 24576 per extra pixel; 16B cap; full base/event/row/stroke/clip/paint/fill/scalar charges
algorithms.job_storage: not converted to accepted job buffers

operations.name: bounds
operations.resources: real KernelResources argument; native implementation supplied by coordinator

operations.name: scanline
operations.resources: real KernelResources argument; row buffers are prepared once and reused

operations.name: preflight
operations.resources: real KernelResources argument; no thread-local budget

job_storage.uses: accepted RasterJob, JobRasterScratch, same ChargeLedger, source identity validation, pre-reserve actual Vec capacity admission and WorkControl loops
not_converted: preflight and actual controlled clip/stroke calls
job_storage.legacy_vec_entrypoints: pure parity/fixture compatibility only; not a production adapter

remaining_gaps: The assigned algorithms still need job-owned buffer conversion for clip boundaries, row construction, fill cache/interval/run buffers and exact work preflight.
